Rules.ExposureRationale: Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Legitimate one-admin-plus-break-glass patterns can be assessed contextually.
Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Five justified admins no longer automatically imply Severe security risk.

Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Regions allowed by a declared residency policy pass; unspecified policy yields Not applicable.
Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Missing owner remains actionable without inflating security score.
Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Organization-wide badge visibility does not dominate weighted risk.

Collection-scoped release job tokens can reach resources beyond the intended project.
Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Approved SSH authentication is not a default Severe finding.
Apply only to a verified applicable failure. Privacy setting is not misclassified as technical security exposure.
